issue.title: Mac pom glossary strand still says polls every 15 seconds
issue.description: The glossary strand sase/memory/glossary/mac-menu-bar-pomodoro-indicator.md still says the mac pom item polls every 15 seconds. After the mac_pom_vault_watch change lands it should say it re-syncs on a change to today's daily note, with a 60s safety poll and a 15s fallback.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Reword the polling sentence: the menu re-syncs on a change to today's daily note, with a 60s safety poll and a 15s fallback when the file watcher cannot start.

issue.creation_reason: Vault-watch change replaces the 15s poll with on-change re-sync plus 60s safety poll, leaving the glossary strand stale
